rounds.title: Textarea baseline
rounds.note: The SDK textarea (et-textarea inside et-form-field), first drawing, drawn by textareaField() from @ethlete/components/design/textarea, which wraps formField() and textarea() from the form-field mock and adds the real form-field-textarea-styles sheet (the form-field mock did not load it), max rows, mixed, et-description and forced states. DOM checked against Storybook Textarea Default, ManualResize, FixedWithMaxRows and Mixed. Box appearance, transparent fill, static label, md size, rows 3 with autosize (field-sizing: content) as the lib default; brand theme, danger as the error theme. Hover is forced on the control frame, focus as data-focused plus focus-visible on the native textarea. Fixtures are fictional: Message, placeholder Write something…, a three-line note to Lena, a ten-line note that grows (long-autosize), the same capped at maxRows 4 (scrolls), autosize off with rows 4 and the vertical resize grip, rows 1, mixed values, no label; required with value Hi and error Write at least 20 characters. Widths 320, 360, 640. Measured in Storybook at 360: line-height 21px at 14px, the same as et-input; maxRows 6 caps at 126px (6 lh) and scrolls inside the frame; the frame block padding was 6px, so the first line started 7px under the frame top, against 14.5px on et-input (min-height 50px, centered). Colour numbers are the text input r1 ones, same tokens: rest frame 1.26 / 1.73, focus (primary) 1.33 / 13.50, error frame 2.30 / 1.72, placeholder 46 % 3.00 / 4.48, required marker 1.33 / 13.50. Decided rules that arise: Q88 (focus frame in ink, invalid in danger ink) and Q99a (required marker light-dark(ink, primary)). Lib bugs apart: (L1) the same et-description bug as text input r1, no inline start padding, 13px left of label, value and hint; b and c drew it aligned. Fixed in the lib, as on the text input. (L3) a textarea was top-aligned inside the 50px min-height frame with only the 6px block padding: rows 1 in Storybook Default drew above 7px, below 22px, the text sat 7.5px higher than an et-input value beside it; b and c padded the textarea frame to (min-height - 1 lh - 2 border) / 2 = 13.5px, so one row centres and every first line meets the input's. Fixed in the lib with the same padding (box appearance, static and floating-outside labels): rows 1 centres like et-input at sm, md and lg (md 14.5 / 14.5), and two lines grow the frame by 15px (56 to 71). (L4) autosize off, resize vertical: the native textarea had no min-block-size, dragging the grip up in Storybook ManualResize shrank it to 15px, the placeholder was cut in half while the frame stayed 50px; not drawable as a static state. Fixed in the lib (min-block-size: 1lh): the same drag now stops at 21px, one line. (L5) Inline label: the textarea kept the 6px block padding there, so in Storybook Default at 216px rows 1 wrapped the placeholder and drew 56px against the input's 50px, one line sat 7.5px under the inline label text, and two lines grew the frame to 56 (static 71). Fixed in the lib: the inline frame takes the same centring padding and the label follows the first line, a rows 1 placeholder stays on one line, and on a coarse pointer the padding counts the 16px font floor; rows 1 now matches et-input at sm, md and lg on desktop and touch (md 50 / 14.5, touch md 50 / 13), and two lines grow it to 71. Design: (1) to (4) as text input r1 (rest and error frame under 3:1, placeholder 3.00, readonly looks editable, hover outshines focus in b and c); c carries the same proposals. (5) The resize grip is the Chromium UA glyph at the textarea corner, 13px inside the frame corner, unthemed, it looks lost in the padding. (6) Scrolled content clips at the textarea edge 14.5px (7px before the L3 fix) inside the frame border, with no fade; a mid-scroll line is cut sharp. Not checked: the scrollbar look, headless Chromium hides scrollbars, so a capped textarea shows no scrollbar in shots or Storybook probes. Later rounds, left out here: underline, filled, floating and inline labels, sm and lg, data-warning, the counter, RTL.
rounds.lost: r1 drew the lib as is (a), the decided rules Q88 and Q99a with the L1 and L3 fixes (b), and the text input r1 proposals (c). L1, L3, L4 and L5 are fixed in the lib since. Tom answered the open design points in Q108-Q113 and Q117-Q118 (commit 23937188b), so r2 draws those rules instead of b or c: rest and error frames under 3:1 in a and b, c's rest frame sat close to its focus ink in light, and no r1 variant made focus the strongest state.

rounds.title: Input design rules Q108-Q113, grip and scroll cut
rounds.note: Draws Tom's input rules Q108-Q113 and the textarea answers Q117-Q118 (backlog-parallel, Input and textarea decisions, 23937188b) on the lib after 685a9c278 (full danger error frame) and 6e5f8eda5 (L5). Contrast, light / dark, against the surface background (WCAG): rest frame color-mix(surface color 50 %, background) 3.41 / 5.09 (was surface-border 1.26 / 1.73); hover, unfocused only, 65 % mix 5.56 / 7.77; focus a 2px frame (1px border plus 1px inset shadow, no layout shift, no halo): d, f, g neutral surface ink 17.93 / 17.18, e theme accent ink 5.48 / 13.50 (brand ink light, mint dark); a focused field ignores hover (focus-hover state). Error frame full danger primary 4.83 / 3.71, error hover danger ink 6.47 / 6.48, error focus 2px danger ink 6.47 / 6.48. Placeholder 60 % 4.69 / 6.79 against the value 17.93 / 17.18 (was 46 %, 3.02 / 4.50). Required marker in the theme ink: 5.48 / 13.50, in error the danger ink 6.47 / 6.48 (was danger primary 3.71 in dark), so Q113's lighter dark danger tone is the existing danger ink token; the r1 contrast exception is gone. Readonly at the rest frame colour 3.41 / 5.09 with a non-colour signal: dashed (d, e, g) or no frame (f); readonly-focus draws a 2px dashed (f: solid) outline in the focus colour, today the lib draws no focus on a readonly field. Disabled unchanged (lib opacity, exempt). Q118: the textarea takes the frame's block and inline-end padding, so scrolled text runs to the frame edge with no fade (long-max-rows, and long-max-rows-scrolled: scrolled 2.5 lines, simulated with a translate inside a clipped slot because a static frame cannot scroll); the clamps add 2 x padding back, which the lib autosize comment says CSS cannot do: it can with calc. Q117: the browser grip, d, e, f in the frame corner (follows from Q118), g 13px inside like today, where a manual-resize textarea keeps the frame padding and its text clips 13.5px inside the border. Q99a/Q102: no mint fill in a textarea, nothing to draw; e uses the ink in light. Open for Tom: focus neutral ink (d) or accent (e; in light its 5.48 sits close to the 5.56 hover grey, told apart by width and hue); readonly dashed (d) or frameless (f); grip corner (d) or inside (g).

a.note: Today, the lib as is. Rest frame 1.26 / 1.73, focus and required marker mint 1.33 in light, error frame 2.30 / 1.72, placeholder 3.00 / 4.48, readonly identical to filled; the first line sat 7px under the frame top (input 14.5px), rows 1 top-aligned 7 / 22 (L3, now fixed); et-description 13px left of label and hint (L1, now fixed).

b.note: Pick. a plus Q88 and Q99a, decided rules only, plus the L1 and L3 fixes drawn: focus frame in ink 5.48 in light, invalid in the danger ink; required marker light-dark(ink, primary); et-description aligned; the textarea frame padded to 13.5px block, so rows 1 centres like an input and every first line meets the input's. Rest, error, placeholder and readonly unchanged.

c.note: b plus the text input r1 c proposals, not decided rules: rest frame surface-interaction 4.74 / 6.94, error frame full danger primary 4.83 / 3.71, placeholder 60 % 4.67 / 6.77, dashed readonly frame. In light the rest frame sits close to the focus ink, told apart by hue only.

d.note: Pick. Q108-Q113 drawn: rest frame 3.41 / 5.09, hover 5.56 / 7.77 on unfocused fields only, focus a 2px neutral ink frame 17.93 / 17.18 that ignores hover, error frame danger 4.83 / 3.71, error focus 2px danger ink 6.47 / 6.48, placeholder 60 % 4.69 / 6.79, required marker in the theme ink 5.48 / 13.50, readonly dashed; text scrolls to the frame edge (Q118), the grip sits in the frame corner (Q117). Cost: the textarea takes the frame's block and inline-end padding, and its autosize clamps add it back.

e.note: d with the focus frame in the theme accent ink: 5.48 in light (brand ink), 13.50 in dark (mint). Cost: in light the focus ink sits close to the 5.56 hover grey, told apart only by the 2px width and the hue.

f.note: d with readonly frameless (border transparent) instead of dashed; readonly-focus draws a solid 2px focus frame. Cost: a readonly field loses its box, so its width and edge read like plain text.

g.note: d with the browser grip 13px inside the frame corner, as today: a manual-resize textarea keeps the frame padding. Cost: its scrolled text clips 13.5px inside the border, against Q118; autosize textareas still scroll to the edge.

h.note: Aligned variant Q140-Q144 for Tom's merge: d (Q140 focus in the surface text colour, Q141 dashed readonly, Q144 grip in the corner and text scrolls to the frame edge with no fade) plus Q143, Q142 and Q151. Q143: rest frame var(--et-surface-interaction-solid), the same token as input r2, 4.74 / 6.94 (was 3.41 / 5.09); the hover takes the input's mix too (75 % interaction + 25 % text colour), 6.69 / 8.94, so both fields match. Q142: readonly-focus a 2px dashed frame in the focus colour, 17.93 / 17.18; readonly a dashed frame at the rest tone 4.74 / 6.94. Q151: error hover light-dark(primary -hover, ink-active), as the lib since 06383b940: light 185,28,28 6.47, dark 239,68,68 4.76, a small step over the error rest 4.83 / 3.71. Unchanged: focus 17.93 / 17.18, error frame 4.83 / 3.71, error focus 2px danger ink. Contrasts light / dark from shot pixels at 360 against the surface background.
